Unfortunately no. Promo codes can't be added after an order is placed, so it isn't possible on this order, even within the 2-hour change window. Only one code is allowed per order.

If you add a pot and want a code, the option would be to cancel the order free from "My Orders" within the window (about 1 hour 40 minutes left) and reorder with the code applied. Note that if you have Leafy Plus, a code can't be combined with member pricing on the same item, and the better discount applies automatically. Also, I can't confirm the plant's stock or price would stay the same on a new order.
